title: One Nix flake to rule them all
summary: This article describes using a unified Nix flake configuration to manage all aspects of a development project, including development environments, builds, and deployments in one centralized location.
problem_solved: Managing fragmented and complex Nix configurations across multiple files and projects by consolidating everything into a single flake.
why_valuable: Provides a reproducible, centralized approach to project configuration that reduces overhead and improves consistency across development environments.
